worktree.setup:
set -e
src="$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH"
cd "$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH"
for f in .env .claude/settings.local.json; do
  if [ -f "$src/$f" ]; then cp "$src/$f" "$f"; else echo "worktree setup: $src/$f missing, skipped" >&2; fi
done
direnv allow .
for d in */service; do
  if [ -f "$d/package-lock.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund); fi
done
